info.name: English Meaning
info.value: to be pleased, to be delighted, to be happy

examples: 'santfzwo BAryayA BartA BartrA BAryA taTEva ca' (manu॰3.60). prIta ityarTaH. ihApi samSabdo nArTe vESizwyaM kimapi karoti.

'dUrvANkurErapi saMBftayA saparyayA kila paraM parituzyasi' (BA0 pu0 5.3.6). parituzyasi atimAtraM prasIdasi.
'vyasanezu ca sarvezu piteva Bavati duHKitaH. utsavezu ca sarvezu piteva parituzyati' (rA0 2.2.33).. parituzyati hfzyati nandati.

'A paritozAd viduzAM na sADu manye prayogavijYAnam' (SA0 1.2). paritozaH prasattiH.
